origin.description: Run code in another working directory.
origin.details: The previous directory is restored after code returns or raises.
origin.example:
dir.create("/tmp/withr-dir-check", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
before <- getwd()
inside <- with_dir("/tmp/withr-dir-check", getwd())
c(inside, if (identical(getwd(), before)) "restored" else "open")

translation.description: Run code in another working directory.
translation.details: The previous directory is restored after code returns or raises. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

os.makedirs("/tmp/withr-dir-check", exist_ok=True)
before = os.getcwd()
inside = with_dir("/tmp/withr-dir-check", os.getcwd)
flag = "restored" if os.getcwd() == before else "open"
return [inside, flag]
